tickets.title: Verify cash distribution readiness
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before initiating or approving a cash distribution:
- Confirm requested gross or net distribution amount: $85,000 initial transfer plus $9,000 monthly transfer after setup
- Confirm source account and available cash: Soren Velvetreed's joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody, $1.18 million total including $73,000 in cash, a $280,000 municipal-bond ladder, and $310,000 of Copper Firefly Robotics stock
- Confirm destination instructions are already authorized or identify required authorization steps: Teacup Comet Bank checking
- Review tax withholding election or required withholding rules: [WITHHOLDING]
- Check for potential trading, liquidity, margin, or settlement constraints: possible municipal-bond ladder or Copper Firefly Robotics share sales to fund the transfers
- Confirm whether the distribution affects the financial plan, income strategy, or required minimum distribution tracking: household recurring spending is about $14,200 per month excluding tuition and home projects, with a $58,000 kitchen repair estimate pending
- Document client authorization and method received: [AUTHORIZATION METHOD]
- Note final processing status and confirmation details: [STATUS]
tickets.evidence: The agreed August 27, 2026 follow-up is to review Soren’s requested $85,000 Teacup Comet Bank checking transfer and $9,000 monthly transfer after setup, including available cash, possible municipal-bond ladder or Copper Firefly Robotics share sales, and any planning impact.

tickets.title: Resolve distribution destination discrepancy
tickets.text: Confirm with Soren Velvetreed the correct destination for the Teacup Comet Bank cash distribution, since Soren read checking account ending 4418 while the custodian record at Velvet Acorn Custody shows authorized account ending 4184. Confirm the correct destination and authorization method before any cash release.
tickets.evidence: By August 22, 2026, the distribution destination needs resolution because Soren read checking account ending 4418 while the custodian record shows authorized Teacup Comet Bank account ending 4184; the correct destination and authorization method must be confirmed before cash release.

tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text: Refresh the household profile using client-provided updates and recent planning notes. Confirm household members, contact preferences, employment status, dependents, trusted contacts, insurance context, estate document status, and any major life changes that may affect planning recommendations. Obtain Soren Velvetreed’s not-yet-uploaded Copper Firefly Robotics separation agreement, final paystub, and consulting contract to update taxable income, benefits, and recurring cash-flow assumptions; Soren left Copper Firefly Robotics on July 31, 2026 and begins a twelve-month consulting arrangement there at $9,500 per month in September 2026.

subTasks.title: Collect profile change information
subTasks.text: Request or compile updates for household members, addresses, contact preferences, employment, dependents, and major recent or expected life events. Obtain Soren Velvetreed’s Copper Firefly Robotics separation agreement, final paystub, and consulting contract.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Revise income, savings, spending, retirement timing, education funding, and family support assumptions in the planning record as applicable, including taxable income, benefits, and recurring cash-flow assumptions from the Copper Firefly Robotics separation and consulting documents.

subTasks.title: Identify advice impacts
subTasks.text: Flag changes that may affect tax planning, risk management, estate coordination, cash flow, or investment allocation recommendations.

subTasks.title: Confirm profile completion
subTasks.text: Review the updated profile for consistency and note any remaining open questions for the next client conversation.

tickets.evidence: The agreed August 30, 2026 follow-up is to obtain Soren’s not-yet-uploaded Copper Firefly Robotics separation agreement, final paystub, and consulting contract to update taxable income, benefits, and recurring cash-flow assumptions.

tickets.title: Follow up on policy renewal details
tickets.text: Contact the client or insurance professional to confirm renewal status, premium change, coverage changes, beneficiary updates needed, and any action required before the renewal window closes. Record received documents and route planning questions to the advisor. Follow up on Soren Velvetreed’s Paper Otter Life universal life policy with a $1.1 million death benefit, whose annual premium notice shows a higher outlay than last year and whose policy-election window closes soon; the household has not chosen whether to pay from checking, reduce coverage, or request an in-force illustration.
tickets.evidence: By September 4, 2026, the Paper Otter Life annual premium review needs follow-up because the notice shows a higher outlay than last year and a policy-election window closing soon; the household has not chosen whether to pay from checking, reduce coverage, or request an in-force illustration.
